scope: Distinct season context for the textbook solstice and equinox figure readings

shots.narration_cue: the longest day in Northern Hemisphere
shots.prompt: One continuous five-second child-friendly three-dimensional animated summer landscape: a sunlit meadow and leafy trees beside a small village, warm golden light, gentle breeze moving grasses, and a smooth sideward camera glide. This is atmospheric context for a long summer day, not a latitude or hemisphere diagram. No people, labels, signs, captions, maps, numbers, writing or logos. No sudden transition and no frozen frames.

One continuous five-second child-friendly three-dimensional animated winter landscape: a quiet meadow with light snow on evergreen trees, cool low sunlight, soft moving clouds and a smooth sideward camera glide. This is atmospheric context for winter, not a latitude or hemisphere diagram. No people, labels, signs, captions, maps, numbers, writing or logos. No sudden transition and no frozen frames.

shots.narration_cue: Spring Equinox marks the beginning of spring
shots.prompt: One continuous five-second child-friendly three-dimensional animated spring meadow with fresh green leaves, small flowers, bright soft sunlight and a few moving butterflies. The camera glides smoothly past one flowering tree in a coherent landscape. This is atmospheric spring context only; exact equinox dates and geometry will be authored separately from the textbook. No people, lettering, labels, signs, captions, numbers or logos; no cuts or frozen frames.
